rooms.name: The Docks of XiXieqi
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the docks of an active seaside village.  Fishmongers
and fishermen haggle over the prices of the seafood in their junks as they
inhale the saline stench of the ocean and the sea life.  Everywhere, 
citizens rush to make purchases of fresh food and imported goods to take
home to their awaiting families.  To the south, east, and west, the docks
continue, while to the north, the open sea invites you for a long sea
journey.

rooms.name: Xixieqi Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the midst of a busy dockyard.  Burly men carry
barrels and crates about the yard while both loading and unloading
cargo from incoming ships and junks.  The scent of fish and seafood
is overwhelming here, making the dockside shops to the east seem very
inviting.  To the north, the docks of Xixieqi meet the open sea, as
ships sail past to dock immediately to the west where the sea foam
comes up over the open pier.  To the south, the street continues, 
toward the heart of Xixieqi city.

rooms.name: Qitiexi Street At The Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the southern end of a dockyard.  Horsedrawn carriages
trot past you as their yellow-skinned drivers scream at you to get out of
the way.  Beneath your feet, you can see where the street that creeps in
from the south disseminates into the common dockyard around you.  To the
north and east, the dockyard surrounds you, while to the south, a street
leads into the city.  You notice the dock end just footsteps away to your
west and opt not to go for a swim in the churning waters.

rooms.name: Qitiexi Street
rooms.desc:
You are dodging fast-moving people and carts in the middle of a busy
street.  Beneath you, the gravel is worn into depressions where many
years of travel along this lane have left their indentations.  The
street continues to the north and south, while shops line the eastern
side of the road.  To the west, a few fishing stalls have opened up 
along the seaside.

rooms.name: Qitiexi Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing just north of a populated city square.  All around
you, yellow-skinned men and women bustle about their daily duties, 
scrambling about their business.  The street to each side of you is 
lined with busy venders; each trying to hawk his valuables on passers-by.
The street continues to the north, while to the east and west, an
herbalist and a fishmonger's stall invite you to examine their wares.

rooms.name: Maoqi Square
rooms.desc:
You stand before an enormous monolith.  Here, three streets converge
as if to pay homage to the black spire which seems to stab at the sky.
Oddly enough, you feel a rhythmic pulsing coming from the spire.  As
you look up at it, you notice thick grey clouds gathering at its tip,
as though they were being drawn into its peak.  To the north, south,
and east, shop-lined streets and shacks invite you to explore this
city.

rooms.name: Dinxi Street
rooms.desc:
You seem to be standing in the residential section of the city.  Here,
older ladies and children converse and play, discussing complaints of 
their daily lives and plans for the future.  To the east and west, shacks
and other small dwellings which house the population line the streets,
while to the south, the street continues further into the residential
part of the city.  To the north, a city square hosts an enormous black
monolith.

rooms.name: Dinxi Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a garbage-strewn street.  It appears
as though the residents of this city care little for the conditions of
the city outside their homes as is evident by the amount of old cloth,
crumpled paper, parchment, and other garbage which lines the streets
on both sides.  To the east and west, you can see homes, while to the
north and south, the street continues.

rooms.name: Dinxi Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a garbage-strewn street.  It appears
as though the residents of this city care little for the conditions of
the city outside their homes as is evident by the amount of old cloth,
crumpled paper, parchment, and other garbage which lines the streets
on both sides.  To the east and west, you can see homes, while to the
north and south, the street continues.

rooms.name: The Corner Of Dinxi And Maojeng
rooms.desc:
Here, the residential district of the city of Xixieqi ends at a
sharp corner.  No alleys provide any space to the west and south, 
though the streets continue to the north and east.  All around you, 
you can hear the noise of screaming mothers and wailing children.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: Xixieqi Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a busy dockyard.  Burly men carry barrels and crates
about the yard while both loading and unloading cargo from incoming ships
and junks.  The scent of fish and seafood is overwhelming here, making the
dockside shops to the east seem very inviting.  To the north, the docks of
Xixieqi meet the open sea, prohibiting your travel as there is no dock
to greet you, while the dockyard continues to both the west and south.

rooms.name: Xixieqi Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a busy dockyard.  Burly men carry barrels and crates
about the yard while both loading and unloading cargo from incoming ships
and junks.  The scent of fish and seafood is overwhelming here, making the
dockside shops to the east seem very inviting.  To the north, the docks of
Xixieqi meet the dockyard, while to the west, you see a main street enter
the dock area.  You notice yet another dockside shop to the south.

rooms.name: Soo Lin Tao's Distillery
rooms.desc:
All around you, bottles of distilled water, brewed rice wines and
whiskeys, and fermenting fruit juices rest in barrels and kegs which
line the walls.
   A single proprietor, Soo Lin Tao looks at you as you enter and
inspect the bottles of alcoholic items he has stored on his shelves.

rooms.name: Hrenchao's Herbs And Potions
rooms.desc:
You stand dizzily as this room's powerful scent of cloying herbs
and sweet roots assail your senses.  All around you, flowers, pollen,
odd leaves, and vapourous potions line shelves and fill open crates
that occupy this tiny shop.
   There is a door to the west, leading to the street and a smaller
one to the east, most likely leading to this shop's storeroom or
second floor.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and sacks as they
rush about their business.  
   You can see an herbalist shop to the north, as it evident by the
sign which bears a twisted ginseng root resting against a pale blue
bottle of liquid.  To the south, you see the wall of someone's two-
level home.  The street continues to the east, and terminates to your 
west where a tall monolith springs from the junction of three streets.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the west is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the west is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the west is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.  This east-west street appears to 
turn sharply to the west, around the side of the home to the north.  To
your south, a locked wooden gate prevents you from entering what appears
to be a ruined temple of some kind.

rooms.name: Temple Of The Sands
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a ruined temple.  A cracked statue lies sideways
on a perched and diased marble altar against the southern wall while
threadbare tapestries lie half-eaten by insects on the floor.
   There is an exit to the north.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a marvelous inn and restaurant.  Tables and
benches line the walls and surround the tables which are covered
with fine seafoods, dumplings, and goblets of wine.
   To the west, you can see the dockyard, while to the east and south,
the restaurant continues.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a marvelous inn and restaurant.  Tables and
benches line the walls and surround the tables which are covered
with fine seafoods, cold sushi, and bottles of fine brews.
   To the west and south, you can see painting and tapestries cover
the walls, while to the north and east, the inn and restaurant
continues.

rooms.name: Distillery Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the back room of a distillery.  Here, barrels of
wine and casks of ale stand open, ready to fill glass bottles for sales
to common patrons.  An enormous crate of bottles stand open, corks
resting in a small box beside them.
   There are no windows here, and the only exit you see lies to the
west.

rooms.name: The Herbalist's Back Room
rooms.desc:
Here, herbs and plants hang in clusters from the ceiling.  Bitter
and foul-smelling roots and garlic seem to overwhelm the more pleasing
scents of ginseng and powdered orangeseed which occupy bottles on the
floor.
   The only apparent exit from this room is back to the west.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and sacks as they
rush about their business.
   You can see the wall of an herbalist's shop to the north, as it evident by
sign off to the west by its door.  To the south, you see the entrance
to someone's home, while the street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A Sage's Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the house of a kindly, old man.  Around you, wicker
and reed furniture invites you to relax and read the tomes of lore on the
shelves of this room.
   As ashtray on a central table shows evidence of burnt opium and a pale
green tobacco.
   The exit is to the south.

rooms.name: A Sage's Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing comfortably in the house of a kindly, old man.
Around you, wicker and reed furniture invites you to relax and listen
to the wise one's legends and tales.
   Smoke from his pipe fills the room with a thick, almost nectar-like
aroma.
   You notice an open doorway to the north while the exit lies to the
south.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a stout, solid house of wood and bamboo.
The place appears to be well-tended and is obviously more than just a
home.  To the south, a warehouse blocks most of the street in shadow,
though as you try the door, you find it solid, as if the door was false.
   The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Warehouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an enormous square room.  All around you, mouse
droppings and rats scuttle about the bare wooden floor, seeking out
any available tidbit of food.
   There are no windows here and only the solid door to the north
provides any exit.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights Common Room
rooms.desc:
All around you, yellow-skinned men and women partake in the feast
which is spread across each table.  To the east, a set of stairs leads
upwards to the sleeping rooms, while to the west, the inn continues.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights Bar
rooms.desc:
Before you stands the bar.  A lanky, yellow-skinned man stands
behind the bar, pouring rice and wheat whiskey into a small class.
On the bar is a registry book.  It appears that the barman is also
the innkeeper here.
   To the north and west, the inn continues, while to the east, 
behind the bar, you can hear the sounds of sizzling food and 
clanging pots.  The southern wall is solid, but boasts an elegant,
if not tattered, silk tapestry.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a damp, musty chamber below the herbalist's shop.
Here, mushrooms grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus
which appears to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming
from somewhere, as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   To your west, you can see a stone wall whose bricks are stacked in
columns and not the usual center-on-edge form.  To the south and east,
the basement of the shop continues.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing below the herbalist's back staircase.  Here, mushrooms
grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus which appears
to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming from somewhere,
as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   The stairs you came down are above you, while the mushroom chamber
continues to the north and east.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and sacks as they rush
about their business.
   You can see a wall to the north, probably part of a house.  To the south,
you see a newly-renovated home, perhaps that of a merchant.  The street
continues to the east and west along this cobbled lane.

rooms.name: An Elegant Home
rooms.desc:
Unlike much of the bamboo city around you, you stand in a home of
wood, brick, and mortar.  Apparently, the owner of this place is
sufficiently wealthy to invest in better, longer lasting materials.
   A lone fireplace rests against the southern wall, and as you 
investigate the home, you find similar hearths in each of the rooms,
all apparently connected to a central chimney overhead.
   The only exit appears to be to the north, the way you came in.

rooms.name: The Channeling Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in a dark room whose shelves are lined with ancient tomes
and bottles of captured wispy gases.  In the center of the room, an
old, wrinkled man in stained robes sits at the head of a wooden table.
   Suddenly, the table begins to rattle, as though it was being lifted
by an unseen force.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the south is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a decrepit house, while to the south, you 
see the local law enforcement facility.  The street continues to the 
east and west.

rooms.name: The Constable's Office
rooms.desc:
You have just entered a busy room.  Here, clerks and other petty
bureaucrats issue and stamp licenses, keys, and permits to foreigners,
tradesmen, and nomads who wish to peddle their wares within the city.
   The constable himself is in the back of the room, mercilessly berating
one of his underlings for some infraction.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the landing of the inn's stairwell.  The hall
extends on wooden floors to the east, where many doors can be seen
lining its southern wall.  Below you, you can see the main room of the 
inn and smell the crispness of chilled and frozen sushi as well as
the steam rising from the shellfish in the kitchen below.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the midst of a busy kitchen.  Yellow-skinned
men and women shout at each other in this crowded room, demanding
more space for their dishes and more wood to keep the cooking pots
and fires hot.  All in the kitchen notice your presence and none 
appear to be happy with you for adding yet another body to the
crowd.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a damp, musty chamber below the herbalist's shop.
Here, mushrooms grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus
which appears to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming
from somewhere, as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   To your east, you can see a stone wall whose bricks are stacked in
columns and not the usual center-on-edge form.  To the south and west,
the basement of the shop continues.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a damp, musty chamber below the herbalist's shop.
Here, mushrooms grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus
which appears to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming
from somewhere, as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   To your east, you can see a stone wall whose bricks are stacked in
columns and not the usual center-on-edge form.  To the north and west,
the basement of the shop continues.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and crates as they rush
about their business.
   To the north, you can see a red-brick wall, which strikes you as quite
out of place in this city of mortar and bamboo.  The brick seems to extend
to the building to the northeast.  To the south, a small, modest home bears
the signs of neglect, as though the owner had died or been too old to tend
it.  The street continues to the east and west, meeting a junction of three
streets just off to the east.

rooms.name: An Unkempt Home
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small wooden hut.  Only one large room comprises this
structure which houses a simple cot, small coal-burning brazier, and a
dry larder.
   Dust is everywhere and appears that no one has been in this place for a
very long time.

rooms.name: Yao Tai's House of Channeling
rooms.desc:
You appear to be standing in an antechamber.  A lone woman is here,
staring at the ceiling as if she hears voices coming from it.  As you
cast your gaze upon her, you notice that she seems to exist in some
different place - as though she were really a projection of the person
she appears to be.
   The room is spartan, with only eastern and western doors.

rooms.name: Nijen's Glass and Lamps
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a glassblowers shop.  Piles of
white sand occupy most of the floor as it spills from holes in burlap
sacks on the floor.  A broad chimney in the northern wall apparently
houses the molten glass which the master craftsman blows into bulbs
for lamps and fashions into shotglasses.
   The exit to this shop is to the south.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a shop of some sort, perhaps a glassblower's
shop judging by the amounts of stained glass and windchimes in the front
of the shop.
   To the south, you see a guardhouse, obviously used to monitor traffic
in and out of the southern gates of the city just to the southeast.
   The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a guardhouse.  Through the eastern window, you
see yellow-skinned guards inspect and question those who enter and exit
the city.
   Here, in the shade of the guardhouse, guards sit around a table, 
playing bones, polishing weapons, and swearing as they gamble and lose
to their companions.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: Ping Xiao's House Of Pleasure
rooms.desc:
You are being pushed around in this massive crowd of drinkers.  Around
you, yellow-skinned men serve food, drink, and hot, moist towels to the
seated patrons who anxiously await their meals.
   Before you is a polished bar.  Spilled rice whiskey and wine add spots
of discolour to the otherwise well-maintained serving area.
   As you look around, you can see that the only way out of this place is
to the south.

rooms.name: Ping Xiao's House Of Pleasure
rooms.desc:
You stand amidst a crowd in this busy tavern.  All around you, yellow-
skinned men serve food, drink, and hot, moist towels to the seated patrons
while avoiding the occasional trip from a stray foot or outset chair.
   To the north, you can see tables, rowdy people, and gamblers playing
around a bar, each here to enjoy themselves in whatever activity they can
participate in.

rooms.name: Qing Crossing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the junction of three streets.  Here, a strange red-brick
tavern greets you with the sounds of fluted songs and the clinking of
glasses coming through its door to the north.
   To the east and south, roughly cobbled streets extend into city,
while to the west, the street runs smoothly on crushed gravel and well-
maintained cobblestone slabs.

rooms.name: Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the crude cobbles of a well-travelled street.
All around you, burly men seem to be coming from alleys and side streets
to enter and exit the building to your east.
   Judging by the number of sweaty, yellow-skinned men leaving the place,
and the sheer size of those who do, it appears to be some sort of sparring
hall or arena.
   The street continues to the north, where it neets a junction at an odd
brick building and to the south, where it extends toward the southern
city gates.  To the west, you see a sturdy fence separate you from an
old hut.

rooms.name: Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the crude cobbles of a well-travelled street.
All around you, burly men seem to be coming from alleys and side streets
to enter and exit the building to your northeast.
The street continues to the north, where it meets a junction at an odd
brick building and to the south, where it extends toward the southern
city gates. To the east and west, you see shops, though barred and
closed windows offer no information as to what they may be.

rooms.name: Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the crude cobbles of a well-travelled street.
All around you, yellow-skinned men and women walk with their sacks
and goods, each eyeing the other suspiciously, as if their wares
were prizes worthy of jealous guarding.
   The street continues to the north and south, while the walls of
buildings prevent travel to the immediate east and west.

rooms.name: Maojeng At Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing at a busy intersection.  Caravans from the desert
and dry plains to the south come northward from the city gates to the
south, all laden with goods from distant lands and the desert itself.
   Streets lead off in all directions, though the gate to the grasslands
and the desert lies to the south.

rooms.name: Xixieqi City Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing among a crowd of people.  Merchant caravans and nomads
speak to the gateguards, occasionally slipping them a few coins as they
pass into the city from the south.
   Just outside the southern gate, you see a lush grassland, but the dry
wind that blows through the gate tells you that the desert is not too far
beyond it.
   To the north, you see an intersection, while you notice you are flanked
by guardhouses to the east and west.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, foul-smelling room.  Crates of bones lie
beside sacks of pestels used for crushing bone shards into powder.  The
stench in here is overpowering and reeks of decay.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Ta'lon Chao's Mystic Marvels
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a foul-smelling shop.  The shelves on the walls
boast a variety of snuff bottles, each containing some powdery substance,
while the wooden counter to the north boasts several strips of glowing
bamboo and other hardwoods.
   There is a door to the north, probably a storage room, while the exit
lies to the south.

rooms.name: Chiang Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on crude cobblestones in the middle of the street.
A few people ignore you as you walk by, though most look upon your odd
skin colour and wonder about your origins.
    To the north, you can see the entrance to some sort of shop.  Its
window boasts stained glass depictions of dragons and its sign appears
to bear some sort of compact bottle.  To the south, a tall establishment
boasts a wide set of wooden, not bamboo, doors.  No signs appear near
nor on the door itself to give a clue as to what the place is.
    The street continues to the east, where it offers more shops, and
west, where it appears to meet a junction.

rooms.name: Martial Artists Training Facility
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an enormous square hall.  Yellow-skinned men as
well as a few women and feisty children spar here with staves, blades,
and bare hands.  All seem to be advancing their level of fitness rather
than their combat abilities, however, as only a few of the fighters
appear to be true masters of combat.
   There are exits to both the west and north.

rooms.name: Moo Shi's Banded Scales and Armours
rooms.desc:
You have entered a well-lit workshop.  All around you, suits of armour
made from sewn metal scales rest on wooden dummies, while scale gloves and
bootcovers hang from strong iron hooks on the walls.
   There is a counter against the eastern wall, where a powerfully built,
yellow-skinned man hammers and shapes tiny metal plates into shape.

rooms.name: Yui Gui Pan's Hides and Tanning
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a tanner's shop.  Hides of desert cattle and
grassland livestock covers the walls, awaiting tailoring into fine
suits of defensive clothing.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a shop of some sort, a cold smithy or
leatherworker's place, perhaps, judging from the yakhide on the sign in the
front of the shop.
   To the south, you see a guardhouse, obviously used to monitor traffic
in and out of the southern gates of the city just to the southwest.
   The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a guardhouse.  Through the western window, you
see yellow-skinned guards inspect and question those who enter and exit
the city.
   Here, in the shade of the guardhouse, guards sit around a table, 
playing bones, polishing weapons, and swearing as they gamble and lose
to their companions.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, cramped room.  Crates of daggers, darts,
and similar weapons rest here, stacked to the ceiling while bundles of
bamboo staves lean slanted against the iron walls.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Claw
rooms.desc:
You stand in an arsenal.  Blades, bows, staves, and other deadly items
line the walls and rest on the floor as a large yellow-skinned man stares
cautiously at you from behind the counter against the northern wall.

rooms.name: Chiang Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on crude cobblestones in the middle of the street.
A few people ignore you as you walk by, though most look upon your odd
skin colour and wonder about your origins.
    To the north, you can see the entrance to some sort of shop.  Its
window shows two hanging daggers and its sign bears a small wooden
shield.  To the south, you notice a windowless warehouse with a sturdy-
looking door.

rooms.name: A Dark Warehouse
rooms.desc:
At first, you think this is nothing more than an old warehouse with
forgotten crates of mouldy goods.  As you look further, though, you notice
that the crates are stacked in defensive positions, to give both seclusion
and secrecy for those behind them.
   In the blink of an eye, a cutthroat appraches you, dagger in reach and
asks you what you are doing here.

rooms.name: Guild Of The Katana
rooms.desc:
This is a featureless room with no windows.  You suspect that there
are secret panels among the wooden walls and floors, but can see nothing
other than the woman standing before you.
   As you look at the woman, you know immediately that she is a thief. A
small knife rests comfortably in her belt while a small set of darts
protrude from the side of her high boots.

rooms.name: Grain Storage
rooms.desc:
You have entered a grain warehouse.  Sacks of grains, both local
and imported, lie in large sacks here, awaiting the owner of the 
warehouse to pick them up.
   You see little of value here and the exit to the south looks like
its about to collapse.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a warehouse, though it could easily be
an enclosed stadium, so high are the walls, while to the south, you
see a very old hut.  The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: An Old City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into two small rooms, both separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of rotted bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, cramped room.  Crates of imported threads
and yarns rest here, stacked to the ceiling while bolts of silk and 
other cloth hang from clotheslines across the walls.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Yuang Li Tao's Fine Silks and Yarns
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a clothing store.  Kimonos, vests, robes, hose,
and slippers adorn wooden models and shelves in an attempt to catch your
eye.  A haggard old woman stands behind a counter, knitting a blanket
with some obviously imported woolen yarn.
   She smiles a gap-toothed grin at you, gesturing to the wares around
her.

rooms.name: Chiang Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on crude cobblestones in the middle of the street.
A few people ignore you as you walk by, though most look upon your odd
skin colour and wonder about your origins.
    To the north, you can see the entrance to some sort of shop.  Its
window shows nothing but its sign bears a bobtail cat playing with
some yarn.  To the south, you notice a small temple of some kind, though
to which deity it may be dedicated to is beyond you.
    The street continues to the east and west, though you notice a sharp
southward bend to it in the east.

rooms.name: Temple of the Ice Dragon
rooms.desc:
You appear to be standing in a cult temple.  Here, yellow-skinned men
kneel, cloaked in white robes, bowing before an obsidian altar.  The room
is domed, clearing showing constellations of the familiar summer sky on
its curved ceiling.  
   You notice one constellation in particular: that of the Ice Dragon, a
mythological beast that swallows worlds with hellish flames and searing
gases.
   All around you, carving and statues of Pan-Lung, the fabled dragon
adorn the statues, walls, and even the exit door to the north.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the east is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A Monument
rooms.desc:
When the first nomads settled this town, they were victims to heavy
winds which toppled their homes and salty breezes which rusted their
equipment.  To prevent these losses, this stone house was constructed
from sea stones and clay.
   Currently, there are no doors on this building, a monument open to
all who reside in Xixieqi City.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a stone structure.  Stone.  In a city of
bamboo and reeds, you question the origin of such a building.  To the
south, you see an old building.
   The street continues east and west, turning sharply north as you go
east.

rooms.name: An Old City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into two small rooms, both separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of rotted bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: The End Of The Hall
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the end of the upstairs hall.  A door in the south
wall sits opposite the open window to the north, when a warm, briny
breeze blows in.  An additional window looks over the rest of the city
to the east.  To the west, the hall continues back toward the stairs.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through the southern and eastern windows, you can see into the city,
while to the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, cramped room.  Crates of common items
such as torches, waterskins, and sacks rests here, stacked to the ceiling
while lanterns hang from dozens of hooks high on the walls here.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Meng's General Wares
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a room full of boxes.  Backpacks, large sacks,
chests, beltpouches, and torches fill the crates and shelves of this
little shop.
   To the north, you see a set of curtains leading to another room,
but it appears to be off-limits to patrons.  To the south, you see
the entrance to the shop.

rooms.name: Corner Of Chiang And Misa
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the corner of two streets.  To your east, you see
the city wall rising high before you.  To the north, you see a shop of
some kind judging by the sign and the backpacks hanging in the glass
window.
   The streets split off to the south and west from here.

rooms.name: Misa Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the eastern wall of the city.  You can hear
strong winds whistling across the desert and dry plains just outside
the wall.
   To the north and south, this lane continues, blocked to the east and
west by both a city wall and a temple's courtyard fence.

rooms.name: Misa Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the eastern wall of the city.  You can hear
strong winds whistling across the desert and dry plains just outside
the wall.
   To the north and south, this lane continues.  A small home is to the
west, and the east is blocked by a city wall.

rooms.name: Misa Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the eastern wall of the city.  You can hear
strong winds whistling across the desert and dry plains just outside
the wall.
   To the north and south, this lane continues.  A stone home is to the
west, and the east is blocked by a city wall.

rooms.name: Corner of Maojeng and Misa
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the corner of two streets.  To the east, the
city wall protects you against the heavy winds that whip about outside
town, while to the south, a large home, obviously in disrepair, slowly
falls to pieces.  You notice with dismay that most of the roof has 
collapsed, blocking the front door with tons of broken reeds and bamboo.
   The street continues to the north and west.
